title: Movie
description: What dwx found in one STR movie file; it goes next to video.y4m and audio.wav. formats/src/video/movie.cpp writes it.

source.description: Path of the file on the disc's volume.

frames.description: Frames in video.y4m: every frame of the file, in order.

first_frame.description: Number of the first frame in the stream (the game counts from 1).

fps.description: Frames per second as the drive feeds them: 150 sectors per second over the sectors each frame takes.

chroma.description: Chroma layout of video.y4m (YUV4MPEG2 C tag).

audio.description: The XA audio decoded to audio.wav (16-bit PCM), or null when the file has none.

source_bits.description: Bits per ADPCM sample on the disc (4 or 8).

playback.description: The movie's entry in MOV_MOVIES (mov.c), or null when the version is not known.

table_index.description: Index the game plays it with (MOV_playMovie).

frame_count.description: The game stops when a frame's number reaches it.
